common.cannotReact: Nothing can react: add a reactant or a product.

a11y.pistonHelp: Move the piston up or down to change the volume of the gas.
a11y.shiftRight: Q is less than K, so the mixture shifts toward products
a11y.shiftLeft: Q is greater than K, so the mixture shifts toward reactants
a11y.atEquilibrium: Q equals K: the mixture is at equilibrium
a11y.reachedEquilibrium: Equilibrium reached: the forward and reverse rates are now equal.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a vessel of reacting molecules, the balanced equation, a gauge comparing the reaction quotient Q with the equilibrium constant K, and charts of concentration and of the forward and reverse rates against time.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area has the reaction menu, a starting concentration for each species, buttons to start from reactants, products or a random mixture, the choice of Kc or Kp, time controls, and Reset All.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Choose a reaction and its starting concentrations, then play and watch Q approach K.

responses.restarted: Restarted from the new starting mixture.
